Title: Premium Container SKU (public preview) will be retired on 30 June 2022

Body.Content:
The Premium Container SKU (public preview) will be retired on 30 June 2022. Please migrate your Windows container applications to the SLA backed Premium V3 SKU by 30 June 2022.  

In addition to generally available (GA) support for Windows containers, Premium V3 provides enhanced performance for production applications, VNET connectivity, and new pricing options. This includes Dev/Test, Pay-as-you-go, 1-year, and 3-year reserved instances. 

Required action  
If you have applications on the Premium Container SKU (public preview), migrate them to the Premium V3 SKU before 30 June 2022.  

Help and support 
If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
